newsitem.title: UK: Ldn gold ends just below $350 target after rally.
newsitem.headline: Ldn gold ends just below $350 target after rally.

text.p: GOLD - Closed $349.90/$350.40, up $3.95 from Friday. Runs into selling pressure after hitting $350 resistance.
SILVER - Four cents up at $4.90/$4.92 but relatively quiet.
PLATINUM - Ends off highs at $396.25/$397.25 but still up $10.25 on concerns over continued Russian export delays.
PALLADIUM - At fresh two year high of $173.50/$174.50, up $9.00. But pared from an intraday high of $175.65.
